wasteGuideItems.instructions: Place directly in green bin or home composting pit. Do not wrap in plastic or polythene carry bags.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Collected daily by door-to-door municipal collection wet-waste tipper.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Drain excess liquids to avoid leachate odor.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Ensure bones or excessive oil are separated if using domestic vermicompost; otherwise safe for municipal wet bin.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Mandatory segregation under Solid Waste Management Rules.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Keep bin lid sealed tightly to prevent pests.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Flatten boxes to conserve space. Remove synthetic adhesive tape and thermocol inserts before discarding.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Hand over dry to local scrap collectors (kabadiwala) or blue recycling bins.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Keep dry; wet cardboard becomes unrecyclable.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Rinse residual beverage, empty completely, compress flat, and recap bottle before placing in dry bin.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: 100% recyclable into polyester fiber and secondary bottles.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Do not throw soiled or oily bottles without rinsing.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Rinse food residues thoroughly. Keep intact whenever possible.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Wrap broken glass in newspaper and clearly label 'Sharp Glass' to protect sanitation workers from injury.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Do not discard in household trash. Deposit at authorized civic e-waste collection kiosks or book a special pickup.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Contains valuable copper/gold and toxic heavy metals.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Do not burn or puncture lithium batteries.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Store in a dry plastic box at home. Bring to ward battery collection centers or designated pharmacy bins.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Heavy metals (cadmium, lead, zinc) contaminate groundwater if landfilled.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Tape the terminals of 9V and lithium batteries with scotch tape to prevent short circuits.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Wrap securely in multiple layers of newspaper or biodegradable disposal pouch. Mark with a distinct red dot.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Directed to high-temperature municipal incinerators to protect sanitation workers.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Never flush down toilets or mix loosely with recyclables.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Do not flush down sinks or flush into drains. Return to designated local chemist collection points.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Prevents antimicrobial resistance and river ecosystem toxicity.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: Keep medicines in blister strips to prevent ingestion by animals.

wasteGuideItems.instructions: Handle gently without breaking glass. Place in original sleeve or cardboard wrapping before disposal.
wasteGuideItems.localRuleNote: Contains mercury vapor which is hazardous to human lungs.
wasteGuideItems.specialHandlingWarning: If broken, ventilate room for 15 minutes before sweeping with cardboard (never vacuum).
